descr:
Milano Cortina 2026
The wait is finally over.

Take a step today,
share the Olympic passion,
and complete the challenge
to earn a special reward.

2026.02.06 ~ 2026.02.22

*Challenge period : 2026.02.06 ~ 2026.02.22
*Reward availability period: 2026.02.06 ~ 2026.02.22

itps.desc:
You’ve taken the first step of a great journey!
Awaken the Olympic spirit within
and head for your first star.
itps.desc2:
First Star Achieved!

You've made a magnificent start, just like the powerful burst of a speed skater. Ready to leap even higher?

> Claim Your Celebration Reward
itps.desc3:
You missed the first star. 
But remember, every athlete starts with a single step! Let's go for a stronger start in your next challenge!

itps.desc:
Time to pick up the pace.
Your second star awaits.
Like Olympians, turn determination into momentum!
itps.desc2:
Unstoppable Run! You’re Full of Energy!

You’ve dynamically earned your second star, like a snowboarder carving through the slopes.

We’re cheering for your relentless Olympic Spirit!
itps.desc3:
You missed the first star. 
But remember, every athlete starts with a single step! Let's go for a stronger start in your next challenge!

itps.desc:
Stopping is not an option.
With passion and perseverance,
reach your third star
and claim your special reward.
itps.desc2:
The Third Star! Absolutely Amazing!

Check out the Special Reward waiting for you. You’ve earned it!

> Claim Your Special Reward
itps.desc3:
Your journey for the second star ends here.
Keep that unyielding Olympic Spirit alive and success will follow next time!

itps.desc:
Four stars! The summit is close!
True Olympic Spirit means never giving up,
even when it gets tough.
Keep pushing forward.
itps.desc2:
Victory is Within Reach!

You’ve reached the 4-star peak with incredible speed. Only one more step remains until your final goal!
itps.desc3:
You missed the third star.
Like a hero who overcomes obstacles, turn this moment into a stepping stone for your next challenge!

itps.desc:
Your incredible journey is nearing its end!
Make one last push and go for the final record!
itps.desc2:
You’ve achieved perfect success!

Enjoy this moment of glory, just like Olympians standing at the top of the podium!

> Claim Your Special Reward
itps.desc3:
So close to the star!
With the passion of Olympians pushing their limits, you’ll surely reach the final goal next time!

title: Together, Milano Cortina 2026
